sql.query: delete from tb_kabm_stat_view where yyyy = ? and mm = ? and dd = ?

insert into tb_kabm_stat_view (yyyy, mm, dd, hh, uv, pv )
select a.yyyy, a.mm, a.dd, a.hh, b.uv, a.pv from ( select DATEPART(yy,reg_dt) yyyy, DATEPART(mm,reg_dt) mm, DATEPART(dd,reg_dt) dd, DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) hh, sum(1) pv from tb_kabm_admin_log a where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt, 'yyyymmdd') = ? group by DATEPART(yy,reg_dt), DATEPART(mm,reg_dt), DATEPART(dd,reg_dt), DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) ) a left outer join ( select t.yyyy, t.mm, t.dd , t.hh , sum(1) uv from ( select DATEPART(yy,reg_dt) yyyy, DATEPART(mm,reg_dt) mm, DATEPART(dd,reg_dt) dd, DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) hh from tb_kabm_admin_log a where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt, 'yyyymmdd') = ? group by DATEPART(yy,reg_dt), DATEPART(mm,reg_dt), DATEPART(dd,reg_dt), DATEPART(hour,reg_dt), user_id ) t group by yyyy, mm, dd, hh ) b on a.yyyy = b.yyyy and a.mm = b.mm and a.dd = b.dd and a.hh = b.hh
delete from tb_kabm_stat_menu where yyyy = ? and mm = ? and dd = ?

insert into tb_kabm_stat_menu (yyyy, mm, dd, hh, uv, pv, menu_id )
select a.yyyy, a.mm, a.dd, a.hh, b.uv, a.pv, a.menu_id from ( select DATEPART(yy,reg_dt) yyyy, DATEPART(mm,reg_dt) mm, DATEPART(dd,reg_dt) dd, DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) hh, menu_id, sum(1) pv from tb_kabm_admin_log a where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt, 'yyyymmdd') = ? and menu_id is not null group by DATEPART(yy,reg_dt), DATEPART(mm,reg_dt), DATEPART(dd,reg_dt), DATEPART(hour,reg_dt), menu_id ) a left outer join ( select t.yyyy, t.mm, t.dd , t.hh, t.menu_id , sum(1) uv from ( select DATEPART(yy,reg_dt) yyyy, DATEPART(mm,reg_dt) mm, DATEPART(dd,reg_dt) dd, DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) hh, menu_id from tb_kabm_admin_log a where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt, 'yyyymmdd') = ? and menu_id is not null group by DATEPART(yy,reg_dt), DATEPART(mm,reg_dt), DATEPART(dd,reg_dt), DATEPART(hour,reg_dt), menu_id,user_id ) t group by yyyy, mm, dd, hh, menu_id ) b on a.yyyy = b.yyyy and a.mm = b.mm and a.dd = b.dd and a.hh = b.hh and a.menu_id = b.menu_id
delete from tb_kabm_stat_potal where yyyy = ? and mm = ? and dd = ?

insert into tb_kabm_stat_potal (yyyy, mm, dd, hh, uv, pv, potal_cd )
select a.yyyy, a.mm, a.dd, a.hh, b.uv, a.pv, a.etc1 from ( select DATEPART(yy,reg_dt) yyyy, DATEPART(mm,reg_dt) mm, DATEPART(dd,reg_dt) dd, DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) hh, etc1, sum(1) pv from tb_kabm_admin_log a where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt, 'yyyymmdd') = ? and etc1 is not null group by DATEPART(yy,reg_dt), DATEPART(mm,reg_dt), DATEPART(dd,reg_dt), DATEPART(hour,reg_dt), etc1 ) a left outer join ( select t.yyyy, t.mm, t.dd , t.hh, t.etc1 , sum(1) uv from ( select DATEPART(yy,reg_dt) yyyy, DATEPART(mm,reg_dt) mm, DATEPART(dd,reg_dt) dd, DATEPART(hour,reg_dt) hh, etc1 from tb_kabm_admin_log a where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt, 'yyyymmdd') = ? and etc1 is not null group by DATEPART(yy,reg_dt), DATEPART(mm,reg_dt), DATEPART(dd,reg_dt), DATEPART(hour,reg_dt), etc1,user_id ) t group by yyyy, mm, dd, hh, etc1 ) b on a.yyyy = b.yyyy and a.mm = b.mm and a.dd = b.dd and a.hh = b.hh and a.etc1 = b.etc1
delete from tb_kabm_admin_log where dbo.formatDateTime( reg_dt - 30 , 'yyyymmdd') <= ?
